run.question:
Alertmanager alert KubePodNotReady (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp since 2026-11-25T20:40:57Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The KubePodNotReady alert for otel-demo/ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp is explained by the pod being Pending and unschedulable, not by an application failure. The pod was created at 20:40:19Z by the new ReplicaSet ad-748fb79cc, whose pod template carries nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=kind-eonvironment-worker (Deployment ad, generation 2). No node in the cluster has that hostname (nodes are kind-environment-control-plane, kind-environment-worker, kind-environment-worker2), so the scheduler reported PodScheduled=False/Unschedulable with '0/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint(s), 2 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector'. Deployment object metadata shows the template was last changed by field manager 'OpenAPI-Generator' via Update at 20:40:19Z, after the helm Apply at 20:32:59Z; the previous ReplicaSet ad-6478f46d8 has nodeSelector null and the same image, so this was a configuration-only rollout. The identical misconfiguration exists on Deployment cart (nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=kind-environmento-worker), and its pod cart-7d54b8686-glfs8 is Pending/unschedulable for the same reason. Existing pods ad-6478f46d8-r2cfq and cart-5bbd5b865c-ksct8 stayed Running/Ready and deployment available/ready replicas stayed at 1, and ad spans in 20:40-20:46 returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with no error rows, so no ad application-level error was observed in this window. The alert therefore reflects the unschedulable replacement pod, while the pre-change pods keep serving. The container of the pending pod never started (no containerStatuses) and its logs could not be retrieved.

claims.text: Pod otel-demo/ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp is phase Pending with no container statuses; its only condition is PodScheduled=False, reason Unschedulable, message '0/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint(s), 2 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.'

Deployment otel-demo/ad (generation 2, pod template spec.template.spec.nodeSelector) sets kubernetes.io/hostname=kind-eonvironment-worker, and its containers list only a memory limit of 300Mi; the cluster's nodes carry kubernetes.io/hostname values kind-environment-control-plane, kind-environment-worker and kind-environment-worker2, so the selector matches no node.

ReplicaSet ad-748fb79cc was created 2026-11-25T20:40:19Z with nodeSelector {kubernetes.io/hostname: kind-eonvironment-worker} and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:3.1.0-ad, while the earlier ReplicaSet ad-6478f46d8 (created 20:33:01Z, deployment revision 1) has nodeSelector null and the same image; the new ReplicaSet has no ready replicas.

Events in otel-demo record Deployment ad 'Scaled up replica set ad-748fb79cc from 0 to 1' at 20:40:19Z, ReplicaSet ad-748fb79cc 'Created pod: ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp' at 20:40:19Z, and Warning FailedScheduling from default-scheduler on pod ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp (count 2, last 20:45:32Z) with the unschedulable message; parallel cart events show 'Scaled up replica set cart-7d54b8686' at 20:40:21Z and FailedScheduling on cart-7d54b8686-glfs8.

Deployment metadata.managedFieldsSummary shows otel-demo/ad written by manager 'OpenAPI-Generator' via Update at 2026-11-25T20:40:19Z (after helm Apply at 20:32:59Z) and otel-demo/cart written by 'OpenAPI-Generator' via Update at 20:40:21Z; of the 26 deployments in otel-demo only ad and cart have a spec.template.spec.nodeSelector, and both values are misspelled hostnames.

Deployment otel-demo/cart (generation 2) sets nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=kind-environmento-worker, and pod cart-7d54b8686-glfs8 is phase Pending with PodScheduled=False reason Unschedulable and the same '2 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector' message; the earlier ReplicaSet cart-5bbd5b865c had nodeSelector null and its pod cart-5bbd5b865c-ksct8 is Running and Ready.

kube-state-metrics confirms the state over time: from the 20:41 sample onward kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"}=1, kube_pod_status_scheduled{condition="false"}=1 and kube_pod_status_unschedulable=1 for pods ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp (unscheduled_time 1795639219) and cart-7d54b8686-glfs8, while ad-6478f46d8-r2cfq has kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true"}=1 and kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"}=1 throughout 20:35-20:46.

Deployment-level metrics for ad and cart stayed kube_deployment_status_replicas_available=1 and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready=1 across 20:34-20:46 samples, while kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable moved from 0 to 1 at the 20:41 sample and stayed 1, i.e. the pending replacement pod is not counted as available but the pre-change pods remain.

In traces for service ad in 20:40:00-20:46:14Z, span group oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (4 rows) and the frontend client spans oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (4 rows) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0, error_rows is 0 for every shown ad group, and frontend /api/data spans return http.status_code=200, so the ad application continued serving requests during the window.

The '1 node(s) had untolerated taint(s)' part of the scheduler message is not what blocks the replacement pod's placement: the only taints are node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule on kind-environment-control-plane and itbench.io/sandbox=true:NoSchedule on kind-environment-worker, and the ad/cart ReplicaSet pod templates tolerate itbench.io/sandbox=true:NoSchedule, so the two non-matching nodes are excluded by the nodeSelector value rather than by a taint.

A container-level failure (crash, OOMKilled, BackOff or failed readiness probe) on ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp is rejected: the pod has no containerStatuses and no restarted container, and its only abnormal condition is PodScheduled=False/Unschedulable, so no container was ever created on a node.

Resource exhaustion or insufficient cpu/memory on the nodes is rejected as the blocker: the FailedScheduling message enumerates only an untolerated taint and node affinity/selector mismatches, and the nodes report KubeletHasSufficientMemory, KubeletHasNoDiskPressure and KubeletHasSufficientPID with 8 CPU / ~32GiB allocatable each.

The invalid hostname values were injected into the ad and cart pod templates by a programmatic client: the field manager string 'OpenAPI-Generator' updated exactly these two deployments within two seconds (20:40:19Z and 20:40:21Z) and no ConfigMap, command-line or other object was observed applying this selector; the actor behind that manager is not visible in the available sources.

Correct the nodeSelector on Deployment otel-demo/ad to an existing node hostname (for example kubernetes.io/hostname=kind-environment-worker) or remove it, then apply the same correction to Deployment otel-demo/cart (currently kind-environmento-worker); the pending pods ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp and cart-7d54b8686-glfs8 should schedule and the KubePodNotReady alert resolve.

gaps: fetch_pod_logs for ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp returned SOURCE_ERROR, so no container logs were read; the pod has no containerStatuses, which indicates the container never started, but application log content for it remains unknown.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so the intent, author and original values behind the 'OpenAPI-Generator' Update of otel-demo/ad and otel-demo/cart at 20:40:19Z/20:40:21Z could not be verified; only the field-manager string and timestamps are visible.
No kube_pod_status_ready / kube_pod_status_ready_time series for ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp were returned by the metric query, so the pod's readiness-condition metric history is unknown rather than zero.
Whether the corrected selector would actually place the pods (for example on kind-environment-worker alongside its itbench.io/sandbox taint) was not tested; only the toleration matching was observed.

No downstream or customer-visible impact was observed or verified: the old ad and cart pods kept serving and ad spans stayed successful within the sampled window, but error rates outside the sampled traces were not exhaustively measured.
The two kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable series are sampled at 60s resolution, so the exact second the unavailable count changed is unknown beyond the 20:41 sample.
next_steps: Review change provenance for Deployment otel-demo/ad and Deployment otel-demo/cart around 2026-11-25T20:40:19Z using the cluster's audit/change history (not integrated here) to identify the client behind the 'OpenAPI-Generator' field manager.
Confirm the intended node placement policy for ad and cart before editing the manifest, then fix the kubernetes.io/hostname nodeSelector values so they match actual node labels.
After correction, verify that ad-748fb79cc-fxgtp and cart-7d54b8686-glfs8 schedule, become Ready and that kube_pod_status_unschedulable returns to 0 for them.
